prose:
The eval asked for a fix to a reentrant-lock deadlock in the retry path of src/queue.ts.
The agent fixed the deadlock in a two-line hunk and the two verifier checks pass, so the
reward is 1. The patch, however, carries three hunks unrelated to the prompt: a whitespace
reformat in src/utils.ts, a new helper in src/retry-policy.ts that nothing imports, and an
env-var rename in src/config.ts. The unrelated-change count is three, all pinned to
specific diff refs. The core fix is sound; the patch scope is the finding.

The reward of 1 follows from the correct retry-deadlock fix; the unrelated hunks are a
patch-hygiene defect, not a correctness one, so the reward stands.

Resolving refs across four hunks and two verifier checks; the unrelated-change count of
three is pinned to specific diff refs and the dead helper is confirmed unreferenced by the
diff review.
The retry deadlock fix in src/queue.ts is correct and passes the verifier.
The patch carries three hunks unrelated to the prompt (the utils.ts reformat, the retry-policy.ts dead helper, and the config.ts rename).
Drop the unreferenced helper in src/retry-policy.ts and revert the env-var rename in src/config.ts, keeping the patch to src/queue.ts.
The added retry-policy.ts helper would trip a lint gate.
Run eslint with the no-unused-vars rule over src/retry-policy.ts before submitting; see web:https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-unused-vars.

ref_conventions.file: file:<path>#L<a>-L<b> resolves iff path is in files[] and 1 <= a <= b <= lines
ref_conventions.tool_call: tool_call:<id> resolves iff id is in tool_calls[].id
ref_conventions.diff: diff:<file>#<hunk> resolves iff (file, hunk) matches a hunks[] entry
ref_conventions.verifier: verifier:<n> resolves iff n is a 1-based verifier.checks[].line
ref_conventions.report: report:<cat>#round<n> resolves iff n is in documents.<cat>.committed_rounds
ref_conventions.scratchpad: scratchpad:<id> resolves iff id is in scratchpads
ref_conventions.web: web:<url> resolves iff url is in web_sources[].url; recommendations only, never findings
